<script>
    // Prevent search box from closing when clicking inside
    function preventClose(event) {
        event.stopPropagation();
    }

    const searchBtn = document.querySelector('.expndable-search-btn');
    const searchBox = document.querySelector('.search-expandable-box');
    const overlay = document.querySelector('.searchoverlay');
    const closeBtn = document.querySelector('.search-close-btn');
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('txtSearchGlobal');
    const clearBtn = document.querySelector('.search-clear-btn');
    const searchResultsDiv = document.getElementById('ul_CompanyListGlobal');

    function openSearch() {
        if (searchBox) {
            searchBox.classList.add('active');
        }
        if (overlay) {
            overlay.classList.add('active');
        }
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        if (searchResultsDiv) {
            searchResultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
        }
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (searchInput) {
                searchInput.focus();
            }
        }, 300);
    }

    function closeSearch() {
        searchBox.classList.remove('active');
        searchBox.classList.remove('has-results');
        overlay.classList.remove('active');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
        searchInput.value = '';
        toggleClearButton();
        if (searchResultsDiv) {
            searchResultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
        }
        // TCC scope search: reset to the free company default on close, so a reopen starts fresh (like the homepage)
        var _tccScope = document.getElementById('tccSearchScope');
        if (_tccScope) _tccScope.value = 'company';
        if (searchInput) searchInput.placeholder = 'Search any Indian company or CIN…';
        var _tccLock = document.getElementById('tccSearchLock');
        if (_tccLock) _tccLock.hidden = true;
    }

    if (searchBox) {
        searchBox.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
        });
    }

    if (searchBtn) {
        searchBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            openSearch();
        });
    }

    if (closeBtn) {
        closeBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            closeSearch();
        });
    }

    if (overlay) {
        overlay.addEventListener('click', closeSearch);
    }

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape' && searchBox && searchBox.classList.contains('active')) {
            closeSearch();
        }
    });

    function toggleClearButton() {
        if (clearBtn) {
            if (searchInput && searchInput.value.trim() !== '') {
                clearBtn.style.display = 'flex';
            } else {
                clearBtn.style.display = 'none';
            }
        }
    }

    function toggleSearchResults() {
        if (searchResultsDiv) {
            if (searchInput && searchInput.value.trim().length === 0) {
                searchResultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
                searchBox.classList.remove('has-results');
            } else {
                checkSearchResultsVisibility();
            }
        }
    }

    // TCC scope search: true when a premium scope is active — the native dropdown machinery below must
    // stand down for premium scopes so it can never re-show the company dropdown over the teaser-lock.
    function tccIsPremiumScope() {
        var s = document.getElementById('tccSearchScope');
        return !!(s && (s.value === 'people' || s.value === 'brand' || s.value === 'website'));
    }

    function checkSearchResultsVisibility() {
        if (tccIsPremiumScope()) {
            if (searchResultsDiv) searchResultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
            if (searchBox) searchBox.classList.remove('has-results');
            return;
        }
        if (searchResultsDiv) {
            const isVisible = searchResultsDiv.style.display !== 'none' &&
                             window.getComputedStyle(searchResultsDiv).display !== 'none';
            if (isVisible && searchInput && searchInput.value.trim().length > 2) {
                searchBox.classList.add('has-results');
            } else {
                searchBox.classList.remove('has-results');
            }
        }
    }

    if (searchResultsDiv) {
        const observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
            mutations.forEach(function(mutation) {
                if (mutation.type === 'attributes' && mutation.attributeName === 'style') {
                    checkSearchResultsVisibility();
                }
            });
        });
        observer.observe(searchResultsDiv, {
            attributes: true,
            attributeFilter: ['style']
        });
        setInterval(function() {
            if (searchBox && searchBox.classList.contains('active')) {
                checkSearchResultsVisibility();
            }
        }, 300);
    }

    if (searchInput) {
        searchInput.addEventListener('focus', function() {
            if (searchInput.value.trim().length === 0 && searchResultsDiv) {
                searchResultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
                searchBox.classList.remove('has-results');
            }
        });

        if (clearBtn) {
            searchInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
                toggleClearButton();
                toggleSearchResults();
                setTimeout(checkSearchResultsVisibility, 250);
            });

            clearBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                e.stopPropagation();
                searchInput.value = '';
                searchInput.focus();
                toggleClearButton();
                toggleSearchResults();
                if (searchBox) {
                    searchBox.classList.remove('has-results');
                }
                // TCC scope search: clearing the box also dismisses the premium teaser-lock
                var _tccLock = document.getElementById('tccSearchLock');
                if (_tccLock) _tccLock.hidden = true;
            });
        }

        // Ensure search results dropdown shows when typing (Home9.js handles the actual search)
        if (searchInput) {
            // Monitor for search results being populated by Home9.js
            if (searchResultsDiv) {
                var resultObserver = new MutationObserver(function(mutations) {
                    mutations.forEach(function(mutation) {
                        if (mutation.type === 'childList' && mutation.addedNodes.length > 0) {
                            // Results were added by Home9.js — but never re-show over the premium lock
                            if (!tccIsPremiumScope() && searchBox && searchBox.classList.contains('active')) {
                                searchResultsDiv.style.display = 'block';
                                searchBox.classList.add('has-results');
                            }
                        }
                    });
                });
                resultObserver.observe(searchResultsDiv, {
                    childList: true,
                    subtree: true
                });
            }

            // Also check on keyup to ensure dropdown shows
            searchInput.addEventListener('keyup', function() {
                // Premium scope: the teaser-lock owns the UI — never let this timer re-show the dropdown
                if (tccIsPremiumScope()) { if (searchResultsDiv) searchResultsDiv.style.display = 'none'; return; }
                // Home9.js will handle the SearchCompany() call via its own keyup handler
                // We just need to ensure the dropdown container is ready
                if (searchInput.value.trim().length > 2 && searchBox && searchBox.classList.contains('active')) {
                    // Give Home9.js time to populate results
                    setTimeout(function() {
                        if (searchResultsDiv) {
                            var hasResults = searchResultsDiv.querySelectorAll('li').length > 0;
                            if (hasResults) {
                                searchResultsDiv.style.display = 'block';
                                searchBox.classList.add('has-results');
                            } else {
                                searchResultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
                            }
                        }
                    }, 400);
                } else if (searchInput.value.trim().length <= 2) {
                    if (searchResultsDiv) {
                        searchResultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
                    }
                    if (searchBox) {
                        searchBox.classList.remove('has-results');
                    }
                }
            });
        }
    }

    // Make preventClose available globally
    window.preventClose = preventClose;

    // Tab switching functionality for search results
    $(document).ready(function () {
        $('.new-search-tabs li').click(function () {
            var tab_id = $(this).attr('data-tab');
            $('.new-search-tabs li').removeClass('active');
            $('.search-content').removeClass('active');
            $('.search-content').css('display', 'none');

            $(this).addClass('active');
            $("#" + tab_id).addClass('active');
            $("#" + tab_id).css('display', 'block');
        });
    });

    // TCC scope search (header): BEGIN — premium teaser-lock, self-contained & revertible
    (function () {
        var input = document.getElementById('txtSearchGlobal');
        var sel = document.getElementById('tccSearchScope');
        var lock = document.getElementById('tccSearchLock');
        var lockTitle = document.getElementById('tccLockTitle');
        var form = input ? input.closest('form') : null;
        var dropdown = document.getElementById('ul_CompanyListGlobal');
        if (!input || !sel || !lock) return;

        var PREMIUM = { people: 1, brand: 1, website: 1 };
        var PLACE = {
            company: 'Search any Indian company or CIN…',
            people: 'Search directors & people (Premium)',
            brand: 'Search brands worldwide (Premium)',
            website: 'Search by website (Premium)'
        };
        var LOCKTTL = {
            people: 'People & director search is a premium feature',
            brand: 'Global brand search is a premium feature',
            website: 'Website search is a premium feature'
        };
        function scope() { return sel.value; }
        function isPrem() { return !!PREMIUM[scope()]; }

        function showLock() {
            if (lockTitle) lockTitle.textContent = LOCKTTL[scope()] || 'This is a premium feature';
            if (dropdown) dropdown.style.display = 'none';
            tccClearLists(); // clear any stale company rows so none linger behind the lock
            lock.hidden = false;
        }
        function hideLock() { lock.hidden = true; }

        // ---- Fast company typeahead via the stored-proc endpoint /api/search/global
        //      (mode=COMPANY). Replaces the slower external /api/global/Search for the free
        //      Companies scope. Premium scopes (People/Brands/Websites) still show the lock. ----
        var tccTimer = null, tccSeq = 0;
        function tccEsc(s) {
            return (s == null ? '' : String(s)).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (ch) {
                return { '&': '&', '<': '<', '>': '>', '"': '"', "'": ''' }[ch];
            });
        }
        function tccClearLists() {
            ['AllDataSearch', 'AllDataPeopleSearch', 'CompanysearchtabData', 'PeoplesearchtabData'].forEach(function (id) {
                var el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.innerHTML = '';
            });
        }
        function tccHideDropdown() { if (dropdown) dropdown.style.display = 'none'; }
        function tccRenderCompanies(list) {
            if (isPrem()) return; // never paint company rows over the premium lock
            var ul = document.getElementById('AllDataSearch');
            if (!ul) return;
            tccClearLists();
            if (!list || !list.length) {
                ul.innerHTML = '<li style="color:#334155;padding:10px 20px;list-style:none;">No companies found</li>';
            } else {
                var html = '';
                for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
                    var c = list[i] || {};
                    var name = (c.companyName || '').trim(); // show the real company name (proper text)
                    var logo = (c.logo && c.logo !== 'NULL')
                        ? 'https://img.thecompanycheck.com/companylogo/' + (c.logo.lastIndexOf('.') > 0 ? c.logo.substring(0, c.logo.lastIndexOf('.')) : c.logo) + '.webp'
                        : '../../images/default-com-logo.webp';
                    html += '<li class="removeborder" id="' + tccEsc(c.cin) + '" data-value="' + tccEsc(name) + '" rel="com">'
                         +    '<div class="search-logo"><img src="' + tccEsc(logo) + '" width="40" height="40" alt="logo" /></div>'
                         +    '<div class="new-search-details"><div class="new-search-com-status"><h4>' + tccEsc(name) + '</h4>'
                         +      (c.status ? '<span class="company-status">' + tccEsc(c.status) + '</span>' : '')
                         +    '</div><p class="search-location-domain d-flex">'
                         +      (c.website ? '<span class="location-border">' + tccEsc(c.website) + '</span>' : '')
                         +      (c.location ? '<span style="margin-left:5px;"> ' + tccEsc(c.location) + '</span>' : '')
                         +    '</p></div></li>';
                }
                ul.innerHTML = html;
            }
            var tabs = document.getElementById('SearchHeaderTab'); if (tabs) tabs.style.display = 'none';
            var ppl = document.getElementById('peopleSearchaheader'); if (ppl) ppl.style.display = 'none';
            var head = document.getElementById('CompaniesSearchaheader'); if (head) head.style.display = 'block';
            if (dropdown) dropdown.style.display = 'block';
        }
        function tccRunCompanySearch() {
            if (isPrem()) { tccHideDropdown(); return; } // guard: never fetch/render for a premium scope
            var q = input.value.trim();
            if (q.length < 3) { tccHideDropdown(); return; }
            var seq = ++tccSeq;
            fetch('/api/search/global?keyword=' + encodeURIComponent(q) + '&mode=COMPANY', { headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' } })
                .then(function (r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : null; })
                .then(function (res) { if (seq !== tccSeq || isPrem()) return; tccRenderCompanies((res && res.data) || []); })
                .catch(function () { });
        }
        // Enter / submit: open the top result if we have one, else the full results page.
        function tccGoSearch() {
            var q = input.value.trim();
            if (!q) return;
            var first = document.querySelector('#AllDataSearch li[rel="com"]');
            if (first) { first.click(); return; }
            window.location.href = '/search/' + q.replace(/[^\w\s]/gi, '').trim().replace(/\s+/g, '-').toLowerCase();
        }

        // Capture phase runs BEFORE Home9.js's bubbling keyup/keypress, so we own the search box:
        // premium scopes show the lock; the free Companies scope uses the fast endpoint above.
        input.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) {
            e.stopImmediatePropagation();
            if (isPrem()) { showLock(); return; }
            hideLock();
            if (tccTimer) clearTimeout(tccTimer);
            if (input.value.trim().length < 3) { tccHideDropdown(); return; }
            tccTimer = setTimeout(tccRunCompanySearch, 200);
        }, true);
        input.addEventListener('keypress', function (e) {
            if (e.isComposing || e.keyCode === 229) return; // let IME candidate-confirm Enter through
            if (e.key !== 'Enter' && e.which !== 13) return;
            e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation();
            if (isPrem()) { showLock(); return; }
            tccGoSearch();
        }, true);
        input.addEventListener('input', function () {
            if (isPrem() && input.value.trim()) showLock();
        }, true);
        input.addEventListener('focus', function () {
            if (isPrem() && input.value.trim()) showLock();
        });

        if (form) form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
            e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation();
            if (isPrem()) { showLock(); return; }
            tccGoSearch();
        }, true);

        sel.addEventListener('change', function () {
            input.placeholder = PLACE[scope()] || 'Search…';
            ++tccSeq; if (tccTimer) clearTimeout(tccTimer); // cancel any in-flight / pending company fetch
            if (isPrem()) {
                tccHideDropdown();
                if (input.value.trim()) showLock(); else hideLock();
            } else {
                hideLock();
                if (input.value.trim().length >= 3) tccRunCompanySearch(); else tccHideDropdown();
            }
            input.focus();
        });

        // clicking outside the search closes both the lock and the results dropdown
        document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            if (form && !form.contains(e.target)) { if (!lock.hidden) hideLock(); tccHideDropdown(); }
        });
    })();
    // TCC scope search (header): END
</script>

<script>
    const mobileMenu = document.getElementById('mobile-menu');
    const mobileoverlay = document.getElementById('mobile-overlay');
    const menuBtn = document.getElementById('mobile-menu-btn');
    const hamburgerIcon = document.getElementById('icon-hamburger');
    const closeIcon = document.getElementById('icon-close');

    let isMenuOpen = false;

    function toggleMobileMenu() {
        if (!isMenuOpen) {
            // OPEN MENU
            mobileMenu.style.left = '0';
            mobileoverlay.classList.add('active');
            document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';

            hamburgerIcon.style.display = 'none';
            closeIcon.style.display = 'block';

            isMenuOpen = true;
        } else {
            // CLOSE MENU
            mobileMenu.style.left = '-100%';
            mobileoverlay.classList.remove('active');
            document.body.style.overflow = '';

            closeIcon.style.display = 'none';
            hamburgerIcon.style.display = 'block';

            // Close submenus
            document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-submenu').forEach(submenu => {
                submenu.classList.remove('active');
                submenu.style.display = 'none';
            });
            document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-menu-toggle').forEach(toggle => {
                toggle.classList.remove('active');
            });

            isMenuOpen = false;
        }
    }

    menuBtn.addEventListener('click', toggleMobileMenu);
    mobileoverlay.addEventListener('click', toggleMobileMenu);

    // Mobile submenu toggle functionality
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        const menuToggles = document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-menu-toggle');
        
        menuToggles.forEach(toggle => {
            toggle.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
                
                const targetId = this.getAttribute('data-target');
                const submenu = document.getElementById(targetId);
                
                if (submenu) {
                    const isActive = submenu.classList.contains('active');
                    
                    // Close all other submenus
                    document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-submenu').forEach(menu => {
                        if (menu.id !== targetId) {
                            menu.classList.remove('active');
                            menu.style.display = 'none';
                        }
                    });
                    
                    // Remove active class from all toggles except current
                    document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-menu-toggle').forEach(btn => {
                        if (btn !== this) {
                            btn.classList.remove('active');
                        }
                    });
                    
                    // Toggle current submenu
                    if (isActive) {
                        submenu.classList.remove('active');
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            submenu.style.display = 'none';
                        }, 300); // Wait for animation to complete
                        this.classList.remove('active');
                    } else {
                        submenu.style.display = 'block';
                        // Force reflow to ensure display is applied before adding active class
                        submenu.offsetHeight;
                        submenu.classList.add('active');
                        this.classList.add('active');
                    }
                }
            });
        });

                                    $(document).on("click", function () {
                                        closeMenu();
                                    });

                                    $(".menu-overlay").on("click", function () {
                                        closeMenu();
                                    });

                                    function closeMenu() {
                                        $(".headernav-dropdown").removeClass("active");
                                        $(".menu-overlay").removeClass("active");
                                        $(".tagglemenu-bar")
                                            .removeClass("open")
                                            .attr("aria-expanded", "false");
                                    }
